title: Simulating Field Experiments with Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating field experiments focused on gender differences (e.g., the impact of gender diversity on team performance) using observer and participant prompting modes, and comparing the LLM's simulated outcomes to the actual real-world experimental results.

Evaluating the LLM's ability to replicate human behaviors driven by social pressures by simulating field experiments on topics like popularity information, reciprocity, and humanizing chatbots, and comparing the simulated response distributions to actual human data.
